text:
elaine: Heads up — Acme asked for clearer CAIQ responses around encryption/KMS, audit logs, and where responsibility lies for PII in prompts. Need final wording for CAIQ grid + an appendix note for the SOW. POC starts next week. Can SEs drop suggested lines?
ben-se: On it. Draft below for 'Encryption & Key Management' (feel free to tweak):
```Encryption & Key Management: Redwood encrypts customer data at rest and in transit using industry-standard AES-256 and TLS 1.2+. For Hosted API, Redwood manages the encryption keys by default. Customers on Dedicated/Private may use BYOK (customer-managed KMS/HSM). Customers are responsible for any secrets included in prompts/responses and should avoid sending highly sensitive keys/secrets via the API.```
sam-devx: Looks good — add a sentence to call out envelope encryption for cached KV and model artifacts.
ben-se: Updated snippet:
```... Redwood manages keys for hosted deployments. For Dedicated/Private, customers may supply KMS (BYOK). Redwood uses envelope encryption for model artifacts and cached KV stores; root key rotation is performed quarterly. Customer responsibility: do not include secrets/PII in prompts unless using Private with appropriate controls and contract language.```
priya-secops: Clarify retention/access for audit logs and SIEM integration. Set default log retention (90 days) and enterprise option (custom retention via add-on). Also mention that Redwood provides audit trail exports and SIEM connectors (S3/CloudWatch/Logpush).
ben-se: Add that line. Also flag network ownership: For Hosted, Redwood controls public endpoints; customers are responsible for securing client environments and API keys. For Private/VPC, connection, peering, and firewall rules are customer-managed.
sam-devx: Proposed CAIQ answer for 'Shared Responsibility' (short):
```Shared Responsibility: Redwood is responsible for the security of the inference platform (infrastructure, runtime, default encryption, and model-serving controls). Customers are responsible for their data, including prompt contents, API key management, and any customer-side network/configuration controls. For Dedicated/Private deployments, responsibility for network controls, KMS ownership, and endpoint access resides with the customer per the chosen deployment model.```
priya-secops: Also add: 'We perform independent quarterly penetration tests and publish summary reports under NDA' — helps procurement.
ben-se: :thumbsup: I'll merge and create a CAIQ cell-ready answer. One small ask: include CCM reference IDs? e.g., CCM-EN-01 / CCM-LOG-03
sam-devx: Final combined text I will paste into the CAIQ grid and the appendix for SOW:
```Encryption & Key Mgmt: Redwood encrypts data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+). Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS by default; Dedicated/Private: BYOK supported (customer-managed KMS/HSM). Envelope encryption used for model artifacts and KV cache. Key rotation performed per our policy; summary available on request. Customers must not send secrets (API keys, credentials) in prompt text.

Audit & Monitoring: Audit logs retained 90 days by default; enterprise retention configurable via add-on. Audit logs and events are exportable to customer SIEM (S3/CloudWatch/Logpush). Redwood conducts quarterly independent pentests; reports available under NDA.

Network & Endpoint Ownership: Hosted endpoints are Redwood-managed. Private/VPC deployments: customer-managed network controls (peering, firewall, egress). Customers are responsible for securing API keys and client-side environments.

Shared Responsibility: Redwood = platform/infrastructure/runtime/security controls. Customer = data, prompt contents, API key management, and deployment-side network/KMS controls for Dedicated/Private.```
elaine: Perfect — I'll paste to the CAIQ spreadsheet and add a line to the SOW appendix. Sending to Acme now. Thanks all :rocket:
security-bot: Reminder: attach NDA request link if sending pentest summaries — https://redwood.internal/ndarequest
